title: GemSim host transport queue-control extension
scope: bounded control queue and event completion only

capability.name: QUEUE_CONTROL_V1
capability.negotiation: must be offered and required by the client; selected by the daemon; absent means queue messages are NOT_SUPPORTED

transport.crc: base protocol CRC-32C over the complete frame

opcode_constraints.failure_ack: echo request_id, opcode, queue_id, generation, and sequence from the structurally decoded request; use the actual daemon UUID, current connection_id, and actual epoch in the response header; value and error_code are zero

error_precedence: DROP_AND_CLOSE invalid envelope, CRC, message type, frame or payload length, header reserved field, or uncorrelatable request
MALFORMED correlatable queue flags, payload reserved field, opcode, or opcode-canonical-field error in a complete 64-byte payload

semantics.CREATE: arg0 is depth in [1, maximum_depth]; queue_id and generation are zero in the request and nonzero in a successful ACK
semantics.DESTROY: queue_id and generation must identify the client-owned queue; succeeds only when no command is pending
semantics.DOORBELL: arg0 is command kind 0 (NOOP), 1 (CONTROL_TEST), or 2 (CONTROL_ERROR_TEST); sequence is strictly previous+1; kind 2 produces only the canonical asynchronous INTERNAL test completion; no address, pointer, packet, kernel, or memory payload is accepted
semantics.completion: a successful DOORBELL ACK is followed by one QUEUE_COMPLETION on the gem5 event queue one tick later; both result headers echo the originating request_id
semantics.identity: every established request must match the negotiated daemon UUID, connection ID, and job epoch; queue handles are scoped to client and generation; every ACK header uses the actual daemon UUID, current connection ID, and actual epoch even when rejecting a mismatched request
semantics.request_id: nonzero and strictly increasing after the HELLO request_id for the established session; exhaustion fails without wrap or reuse; ACK and completion echo the originating value; tracker advances only after structural, version, identity, and capability validation succeeds
semantics.indeterminate_ack: after a complete request record is sent, timeout, cancellation, EOF, or protocol failure before a canonical ACK poisons and closes the client session so daemon disconnect cleanup rolls back all queue state; a canonical non-OK ACK is determinate
semantics.completion_retry: deadline and cancellation are checked before consuming a buffered completion; timeout or cancellation while waiting for a previously acknowledged DOORBELL leaves that sequence and any buffered completion pending and wait may be retried; a malformed, foreign, or noncanonical completion poisons the session
semantics.disconnect: disconnect invalidates queues and pending callbacks; callbacks validate request_id, client fd generation, and queue generation before emitting a completion
semantics.runtime_handle_ownership: sagr_queue_t is unique ownership; copied aliases must not be passed after successful destroy or instance close; deterministic stale rejection applies to wire queue_id plus generation while the local handle is alive
semantics.unsupported: a connection without QUEUE_CONTROL_V1 receives UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY and no queue state is created
